newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles sees 10-11 pct profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles sees 10-11 pct profit growth.

text.p: Equipment hire and logistics firm Brambles Industries Ltd has said it was comfortable with forecasts of 10 to 11 percent profit growth for the current 1996/97 year, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Monday.

"Most of the brokers take the view that double-digit (profit) growth is probably an expectation for us again -- the mid-point about 10 or 11 percent growth," Brambles chief executive John Fletcher told paper.
"As far as we can see, just two months into this year, we wouldn't be unhappy with that sort of outcome," he said.

Last Friday, Brambles reported a rise in 1995/96 net profit to A$215.1 million (US$169.9 million) from A$97.7 million in 1994/95, but the previous year's result was undermined by a large abnormal loss. Pre-abnormal profits rose 15.8 percent to A$214.8 million, at the top end of analysts expectations.
Brambles said only on Friday that it expected further profit growth in 1996/97 despite uncertainty in the Australian and European economies.
Brambles shares closed up five cents at A$18.90 against a soft market overall on Friday.
